THE NEWSLETTER 

Автор: Volkswagen Group


Автор: Volkswagen Group

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/september-spotlights-volkswagen-group-9a3he?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BYoz8h4vgQyOv8N4nxzTjog%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=065E7cuwufrYs1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mupbicj0~kg-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mupbicj0-kg
  
Welcome to our September Newsletter! This month, we highlight how the Volkswagen Group is shaping its future through strategic transformation, sustainable growth and groundbreaking innovations in electric mobility. From the approval of the Volkswagen Group’s Future Plan 2030 and important leadership developments to new milestones in sustainability and portfolio management, the Group continues to strengthen its competitiveness and long-term resilience. At the same time, a record-breaking range milestone from Škoda, together with new developments from Audi and Volkswagen, highlights the Group’s continued progress in electric mobility, efficiency and the expansion of accessible EVs across Europe. 🔍 Explore the 6️⃣ highlights that shaped this month: 🚗 1. Future Plan 2030: Volkswagen Group Sets the Course for the Future The Supervisory Board has unanimously approved the Volkswagen Group’s Future Plan 2030, marking an important step in the company’s transformation. The plan includes significant investments in new products, technologies and future growth areas, supported by more efficient structures and improved competitiveness. 💬 Oliver Blume, CEO Volkswagen Group: “The Supervisory Board has unanimously approved the Executive Board’s Future Plan presented today. This is a strong sign for the future of the Volkswagen Group. We are taking responsibility for our entire team, for our partners and for industrial jobs worldwide. Over the coming years, we will invest a three-figure billion sum to make our iconic brands even more attractive, stronger and more competitive.” 🔗 Further details: How the Volkswagen Group is enhancing its future viability | Volkswagen Group As part of the future-focused strategy, the Supervisory Board also appointed Erika Rasch as Board Member for Human Resources at Volkswagen AG. In addition, Volkswagen, the State of Lower Saxony, and Aurelius Capital agreed on key terms for the sale of Volkswagen Osnabrück GmbH. The site is planned to evolve into a competence center for security and defense solutions, with the objective of securing the location and the majority of jobs in the long term. 🤖 2.
